title: 2020 AMC 10A Problem 10
statement: Seven cubes, whose volumes are \(1,\) \(8,\) \(27,\) \(64,\) \(125,\) \(216,\) and \(343\) cubic units, are stacked vertically to form a tower in which the volumes of the cubes decrease from bottom to top. Except for the bottom cube, the bottom face of each cube lies completely on top of the cube below it. What is the total surface area of the tower (including the bottom) in square units?

solutions.text:
The cube side lengths are \(1,2,3,4,5,6,7\), stacked from largest on bottom to smallest on top. The sum of the surface areas of the separate cubes is \(6(1^2+2^2+\cdots+7^2)\) \(=6\cdot140=840\).

Each contact hides two square faces, with areas \(1^2,2^2,\ldots,6^2\). Subtracting these hidden faces gives \(840\) \(-2(1^2+2^2+\cdots+6^2)\) \(=840-182=658\). Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: Start with the surface areas of all seven separate cubes
